milestone: Blocked: evidence judging needs a language-model provider
summary: Teacher authoring, approval, privacy, the three learner phases and traceability work and are covered by 48 engine tests and 34 browser checks. Independent validation (two simulated teachers, a cold auditor, three simulated students, an evidence evaluator) found that feedback cannot reliably tell stating a misconception from rejecting it, or credit correct work phrased in other words. Six repair rounds of word-matching rules reduced but did not remove these errors. Contract commitment C6 (evidence-grounded feedback) is not met. Next step needs a language-model provider, which needs an API key this environment does not have.
